description: This file defines a Sendgrid class for interacting with Sendgrid APIs, including methods for retrieving user info, contact IDs, and custom field IDs, utilizing the Sendgrid client library and logger.

classes.name: Sendgrid
classes.description: A class for communicating with Sendgrid APIs, handling user info, contacts, and custom fields.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Sendgrid class, setting the API key from parameter or environment variable.

methods.name: username
methods.description: Fetches the username associated with the Sendgrid account.

methods.name: sendgridRequest
methods.description: Performs a request to Sendgrid API with error handling.

methods.name: getSendgridContactId
methods.description: Retrieves Sendgrid contact ID(s) based on email.

methods.name: getSendgridCustomFieldsIds
methods.description: Gets or creates custom field IDs in Sendgrid based on provided options.
